meta.title: Task Board
meta.description: Board and list panels: tasks run for real through DSH sessions and report their status back. Data lives on the host, so every device sees one copy.

en.attach.legacyFilesLost: These older attachments cannot be recovered — please pick them again: {names}
en.attach.rejectDecode: "{name}" could not be decoded as an image
en.attach.rejectNoStore: This host has no attachment store, so "{name}" cannot be attached
en.attach.rejectSize: "{name}" is still too large after compression
en.attach.rejectType: "{name}" is not a supported image type
en.auto.empty: No automation active yet: enable "Automation" in a task's detail, or add a "Session rule" to a task.
en.auto.form.hint: A leading / runs through the command registry; queue = into the dispatcher, steer = immediately.
en.auto.form.hintLoop: Continues after completion: it fires from the NEXT completion (a comment or a chat counts); each round fires the next only after it succeeds; queue = in order, steer = immediately (both budget-bound; stop it any time).
en.auto.form.instructionPlaceholder: The custom instruction to send this session on schedule; a leading / runs through the native command registry…
en.auto.form.noSession: This task has no sessions yet: drag a session into the task first to add a session rule.
en.auto.form.promptAttach: The run prompt currently carries {n} attachment(s); they go out with every firing
en.auto.form.promptAttachNone: The run prompt carries no attachments right now, so this rule sends the text only
en.auto.form.promptEmpty: Cannot save: this rule sends the task's run prompt, and it is empty. Fill in the run prompt first, then save this rule.
en.auto.form.saveFailed: Failed to save the rule. Please try again.
en.auto.form.usePromptHint: Sends the task's CURRENT run prompt (edits apply at once); with On schedule = timed injection, with After completion = keeps continuing, round after round.
en.auto.rule.awaitingTitle: Armed: the first instruction fires at the next completion (a comment or a chat in the session counts); after that, each successful round fires the next one until it is turned off or the session disappears.
en.auto.rule.deleteArmed: The rule for “{name}” is switched ON — it posts into that conversation on its own schedule. Deleting it stops that for good.
en.auto.rule.deleteConfirm: Delete the rule for “{name}”? The wording and the trigger are gone with it, and there is no way back.
en.auto.rule.onComplete: Continues after completion, round after round
en.auto.title: Automation
en.board.activityGroupRest: {n} more folded — open the task for all
en.board.activityPreviewHint: Happened at {time}; open the task for full context
en.board.activityTitle: Board activity: creations, starts, completions, comments, external turns, direct sends (read-only, rows open the task)
en.board.automationTitle: Manage task-level auto-run and session rules in one place
en.board.bundleStale: Page runs an old bundle ({c} vs server {s}) · tap to force reload
en.board.bundleStaleHostOld: The server still runs an older version (page {c} / server {s}) · a refresh cannot fix it; restart dsh web
en.board.bundleStaleHostOldTitle: The package on disk is newer than the running host process. Reloading the page cannot fetch a newer host — restart dsh web. Board data is untouched.
en.board.bundleStaleTitle: This page still runs the previous client bundle while the server already serves a newer one. Tap to reload and pick it up; board data is untouched.
en.board.cruiseCalendar: Open the calendar to pick a date
en.board.cruiseLimit: Concurrency cap (default 5: at most N sessions running at once, comments included)
en.board.cruiseScheduleEmpty: No windows yet: set a start time to auto-enable; optionally an end; an end before the start crosses to the next day.
en.board.cruiseSemanticsHint: Start = auto-on · end = auto-off · end before start = next-midnight morning (one night only)
en.board.cruiseStatusManualOff: Turned off manually · window still live until {time}
en.board.cruiseStatusManualOffHold: Turned off manually · window stays on
en.board.cruiseTitle: Auto-cruise: runs all todo tasks board-wide within the concurrency cap (comments inject through the same dispatcher)
en.board.cruiseWindowErrorDuplicate: This window already exists: adjust the start or end
en.board.cruiseWindowErrorEndPast: End time is in the past: it must be later than now
en.board.cruiseWindowErrorRange: End {end} is {days} day(s) before start {start}: cross-midnight is one night only (e.g. 22:00 → 02:00) — check the dates
en.board.cruiseWindowErrorSame: Start and end are the same: put the end after the start (or early the next day)
en.board.cruiseWindowErrorStart: Pick a start or end time first
en.board.cruiseWindowErrorStartPast: Start time is in the past: it must be later than now (blank = start now)
en.board.deleteSelectedConfirm: Deleted tasks and their run records cannot be recovered; checklist rows hung on them go back to “not on a card” (the rows themselves are not deleted).
en.board.demandTitle: Need you = a session is suspended on your answer. In review = a card finished and you have neither opened that session nor approved or sent it back. Opening the card only shows a summary; to clear a reminder, open the session.
en.board.dragRejectBusy: A round is still running, so this cannot move to {column}. Wait for it, or steer it.
en.board.engineNoteBoot: This server process started at {time}. If that is not the restart you just did, the address is serving you from a different instance.
en.board.engineNoteBootUnknown: This server has not reported a boot time (a host older than this board build).
en.board.engineNoteStaleMulti: If you have confirmed a restart yet this still shows, the current address is most likely connected to a DIFFERENT, un-restarted server process (another port/instance) — restart that one, or press Re-check to confirm.
en.board.engineStaleHint: The board plugin ships a newer engine-seat protocol (visibility preemption), but the running host process is older — host changes need a dsh web restart. Until then the seat may stay on a background device and queued work waits.
en.board.engineViewerHint: Scheduled work and queued comments run on the seat holder; a visible device takes the seat over when that one is hidden. Queued comments are waiting for it.
en.board.flowStatsTitle: Flow over the last four weeks: p85 is how long the slowest 15% took to clear a column (smaller is smoother), throughput is how many finish per week. Shown only while work is queued.
en.board.newFromSessionsTitle: Pick existing sessions and create one card carrying them, in the To plan column.
en.board.notifyApproveBlocked: Sessions on this card are still running · approve or send back after they finish
en.board.notifyMarkGroupTitle: Clear unread reminders on the review rows in view (content stays; waiting rows are untouched)
en.board.organizeRunTitle: Run every selected executable card (blank prompts stay put; the concurrency cap throttles)
en.board.organizeTitle: Tidy: enter selection mode — pick several cards, then run, recolour or delete them in one go.
en.board.title: Task Board
en.board.update.applied: Updated to {v} — the page loads the new build by itself.
en.board.update.appManaged: The desktop app owns this profile and the terminal’s dsh will not accept it: update it by uninstalling and reinstalling from the app’s Plugins page.
en.board.update.evidence: The running code is not where the declaration says; it was identified by where it actually is.
en.board.update.gitBehind: New commits on origin ({head} → {remote}) — the update pulls them.
en.board.update.gitDirty: Uncommitted changes in the worktree — stash or commit before updating.
en.board.update.gitRemoteUnread: origin could not be reached: every reading was silent (api.github.com first, then github.com over git — both unreachable or timed out), so whether it has new commits cannot be judged. The command below still works.
en.board.update.gitSameVersion: The remote declares the same version; its branch may still carry commits that did not change it.
en.board.update.gitUnreadable: This checkout’s git state cannot be read (no git command, or the directory is not a repository), so whether origin has new commits cannot be judged. The command below still works.
en.board.update.gitUpToDate: The local checkout is in sync with origin.
en.board.update.hint.github: GitHub install: you can also run the command below in a terminal.
en.board.update.hint.local: Local checkout: you can also run the command below in the repository.
en.board.update.hint.npm: npm install: you can also run the command below in a terminal.
en.board.update.losingConnection: Updating — the page may lose its connection briefly. That is expected; refresh afterwards.
en.board.update.noLatest: The latest version could not be read (network or source unreachable).
en.board.update.overwrite: Update now installs straight over this copy; DSH needs a restart afterwards.
en.board.update.reason.dirty: The worktree has uncommitted changes — commit or stash them first.
en.board.update.reason.failed: The update command did not succeed; its last output is below.
en.board.update.reason.timeout: The update timed out and was stopped.
en.board.update.reason.toolMissing: A command the update needs is not installed on this machine.
en.board.update.reason.unavailable: This host carries nothing that can apply the update.
en.board.update.reason.unsupported: This installation has no update path to apply.
en.board.update.rebuilt: Pulled and rebuilt to {v} — restart DSH to take effect.
en.board.update.reinstall: Update now uninstalls the plugin and installs the new version: it disappears briefly, and DSH may need a restart. If the install fails the plugin stays uninstalled — put it back the way you installed it.
en.board.update.remoteVersion: Version on the remote default branch: {v}
en.board.update.restart: An update may need a DSH restart: rerun dsh web, or fully quit and reopen the desktop app. Board data is untouched.
en.board.update.restartRequired: Updated to {v} — restart DSH to take effect.
en.board.update.title: Plugin update
en.board.update.unchangedHeld: pnpm’s supply-chain window (a freshly published version waits out an observation period) is holding back {latest}: press again later, or uninstall and install {spec} from the Plugins page.
en.board.update.unreadable: This profile declares no install spec for the package, so there is no command to give. Reinstall it the way you installed it.
en.board.update.unrouted: It was installed from “{spec}”, which has no update command here. Reinstall it the way you installed it.
en.card.autoPausedFailedTitle: The last automated run failed and auto-run is paused (task is in review)
en.card.awaitingDecisionTitle: That conversation finished and you have neither read it nor ruled on it. Opening the card only shows a summary — to clear this, open that session, or approve / send it back.
en.card.batchProgress: Batch progress (runs so far / total runs)
en.card.chainingTitle: Running · continues automatically after each completion
en.card.commentQueueTitle: {n} saved comments waiting to be injected (they run in order once auto cruise is on and a slot is free)
en.card.mountedDoor: Open the checklist filtered to this card
en.card.newCommentTitle: This card has comments you have not read
en.card.newContentTitle: Unviewed content (new run result or new comments) — open to review
en.card.nextFailed: Failed · steer with a comment or rerun
en.card.nextQueued: Queued {n} · injects in order when cruise is on
en.card.nextWaitingMany: {n} sessions need you · open to handle them one by one
en.card.quickRun: Quick run: starts a fresh round with the current prompt
en.card.waitingTitle: The session is waiting for you ({kind}): open the card to handle it
en.delete.confirm: Delete “{name}”? This cannot be undone; checklist rows hung on this card go back to “not on a card” (the rows themselves are not deleted).
en.delete.title: Delete Task
en.detail.duplicateTitle: Create a new backlog card from this task (runs, links and session rules are not copied; the schedule comes along disarmed)
en.detail.editDraftRestored: Restored your last unsaved edits (cleared on save or cancel)
en.detail.editSaveFailed: Not saved — this card may have just been changed or deleted on another device. Your edit is still here; check it and save again.
en.detail.executionHint: The status is this run's own outcome; comments and follow-ups appear in the row dynamics and the review page
en.detail.hideRow: Hide this row (display only — not archived, not deleted; numbering stays stable)
en.detail.idleHint: The session has no active conversation
en.detail.moveBlockedBusy: This run is still going. You can move the card once it lands.
en.detail.promptEmpty: The run prompt is the body text, so write the body first.
en.detail.renameSessionTitle: Rename session (syncs with the native session list)
en.detail.rerunHint: Start a fresh round with the current run prompt (comments continue the old session)
en.detail.runBlockedBusy: This task already has a round running: wait for it, or steer it.
en.detail.saveTemplateTitle: Save this content to the template library (no bindings/runs/automation; start new tasks from it)
en.detail.schedule.blockedAction: Cannot enable: fill in the execution prompt so there is something to run.
en.detail.schedule.blockedSession: A session rule sends an empty execution prompt
en.detail.schedule.chainNote: Each completed run starts the next automatically; the chain stops on failure or budget. Running keeps the task in progress.
en.detail.schedule.invalidRuns: Run count must be an integer ≥ 1 (blank = unlimited)
en.detail.schedule.mode.chainHint: Start the next run as soon as the previous one completes
en.detail.schedule.paused.backlog: The task is shelved in Backlog, so auto-run is paused: hit "Run" to start now, or move it to To Do to continue on schedule.
en.detail.schedule.paused.done: Task is Done: auto-run is paused — move it back to To Do to resume on schedule.
en.detail.schedule.paused.review: The task is in Review, so auto-run is paused: after reviewing, hit "Run Again" to continue, or move it to To Do to take over.
en.detail.schedule.pausedFailed: The last automated run failed, so auto-run is paused.
en.detail.schedule.presets.deleteConfirm: Delete “{name}”? You wrote this one yourself, and it is not kept anywhere else.
en.detail.schedule.presets.name: Name
en.detail.schedule.presets.restoreConfirm: This clears all {n} custom presets and restores the built-in defaults. Continue?
en.detail.schedule.presets.title: Manage presets
en.detail.schedule.refused: This automation could not be enabled.
en.detail.schedule.stopChainConfirm: No further run starts automatically after stopping; re-enable it in Automation whenever you want it back.
en.detail.schedule.unlimitedConfirm: Run-after-completion starts the next run immediately after each one finishes, repeating forever (continuously consuming real sessions and resources). Enable it? You can also set a "Max runs" budget to cap the loop.
en.detail.sessionArchived: This session is archived — restore it in Settings → Archived sessions
en.detail.sessionDrivePlaceholder: Comment here to drive this task in this session…
en.detail.sessionNewHint: Creates a fresh session from the run configuration below and adds it to this task's session list; title/description/prompt belong to the task and are not set here.
en.detail.sessionNewTitleFailed: The session was created and added to the list, but the title did not apply: {error} (rename it on the session row)
en.detail.sessionNewTitleHint: Leave blank to let the host name it automatically (generated after the first message); fill it in to name it now and pin the title against auto-renaming.
en.detail.sessionRemoveConfirm: This session's comments and run records on this task will be deleted permanently and cannot be recovered; the task and its other sessions stay untouched.
en.detail.sessionRemoved: This session was removed from this task — drag it back onto the card to re-add it
en.detail.sessionUnavailable: This session is no longer available
en.detail.title: Task Detail

en.gallery.dialogBody: This is the Dialog component itself — the same backdrop, the same focus ring, the same Escape stack.
en.gallery.dialogOpen: Open: Escape closes it, focus stays inside, the backdrop closes it too.
en.gallery.frameBody: All three pages share this frame: the bar on top, warnings only when something is wrong, the page filling the rest.
en.gallery.frameNotice: The server is still running an older version — refreshing will not help, restart dsh web
en.gallery.frameNoticeQuiet: This one only informs; it is not a button.
en.gallery.mixedRowSpecimen: Four type sizes plus a dot and a share bar, sharing one midline
en.gallery.mixedRowWhy: A row holding a graphic or two type sizes is centred on the box centre, with each run at line-height 1em. This is the one visual law that must have a gate: its error is half a pixel, the eye cannot settle it, and a written-down compensation flips sign on the next machine.
en.gallery.note: This page does two things: it puts everything the system contains on one screen, and it proves the panels render those same parts — every specimen below is the real component. It holds no board or checklist data.
en.gallery.sharedCandidatesWhy: This is a record, not a to-do list: each entry says why the second page has not needed it yet. The list and the count in the tests check each other both ways.
en.gallery.title: Design system
en.gallery.typeSpecimen: Keep the work in hand — nothing dropped, nothing done twice
en.home.emptyBody: Create a card, or make one from a conversation — finished work writes its status back here.
en.home.flowEmpty: Cycle time and throughput appear after two cards are finished
en.home.loadFailed: The board is not ready, so this page cannot read its numbers
en.home.sessionsEmpty: Nothing is in flight right now. Finished sessions live on their cards.
en.home.subtitle: {n} things need you
en.home.tile.demandHint: A conversation stopped to ask you
en.home.tile.reviewHint: Finished work nobody has looked at
en.home.title: Today
en.item.agenda.quietNote: Which days are empty, and how many rows were left out. Finished rows are off the agenda; rows just noted are not on a day yet.
en.item.archive.bar: Removed rows stay for 30 days, then clear themselves.
en.item.archive.batchRefused: This device cannot reach the host. Nothing was erased.
en.item.archive.confirm: Erase the {n} picked rows? They cannot come back.
en.item.archive.destroyed: Erased {n} rows for good. They cannot come back.
en.item.archive.destroyedNone: Nothing was erased: {m} could not be.
en.item.archive.destroyedPartial: Erased {n} rows for good; {m} could not be erased.
en.item.archive.title: Removed
en.item.archive.unreadable: Cannot reach the host record of what you removed.
en.item.archive.window: You can bring one back for 30 days after removing it.
en.item.ask.configNote: No card yet: handing it over opens one with this configuration, and the card keeps it — change it there afterwards.
en.item.ask.continues: It is running, so this will be said into that conversation.
en.item.ask.refused: Could not reach a model: {why}. The item is still here; nothing was lost.
en.item.ask.said: Handed to the model in {sessionId}; it takes it from here.
en.item.ask.started: Started: the card moved to “In progress” on the board.
en.item.ask.why.busy: the card is just starting and has not resolved a conversation yet; ask again once it speaks
en.item.ask.why.empty: this row has nothing to send
en.item.ask.why.unavailable: this device cannot drive the engine and is not relaying; try another window
en.item.batch.askOne: Only the ones hanging off a card can be asked — {n} rows were selected.
en.item.batch.saidNone: All {n} were already that; nothing changed.
en.item.bucket.behindWhy: The day these were planned for has passed and the work is not done. They will not fix themselves: change the date, or finish the work.
en.item.bucket.hardOverdueWhy: The deadline has passed. They will not clear themselves: change the date, or finish the work.
en.item.cardLink.configNote: The card this opens is born with this configuration; nothing runs yet, so change it later on the card or in this row's detail.
en.item.cardLink.note: Link an existing card and nothing inside it changes; make a new one and this row's title and body open it. Once linked, the two sides keep their own names.
en.item.cardName.empty: Give the card a name first.
en.item.cardName.label: Name of the new card
en.item.create.blank: A title is enough to save it — the body can come later.
en.item.create.dateBad: One of these dates could not be read — the field below it says so.
en.item.create.datesAny: All three may be left empty, and one on its own counts.
en.item.create.refused: Could not save it: it repeats one you already have, or it has no name yet.
en.item.create.title: New row
en.item.create.titlePlaceholder: A sentence is enough — it is the title
en.item.dates.bad.impossible: {word} is not a day. Months run 1-12, and the day has to exist in that month.
en.item.dates.bad.past: {word} has already passed this year. To say which year, write it in (2026-09-10 or 2027-09-10).
en.item.dates.bad.unreadable: I could not read this one: {word}. Try 2026-10-15, tomorrow, Wed or +3.
en.item.dates.contradict: {a} falls after {b}, so this row contradicts itself
en.item.empty: Write one down — it looks like this:
en.item.field.bodyHint: Markdown; write as many lines as you need.
en.item.field.notesHint: Where this row came from and what it is for; it travels with the row when you hand it to the AI
en.item.field.title: Title
en.item.filters.label: Filter:
en.item.gated.hint: Their start day has not come. They sit here until then, and move into a day section on the day.
en.item.hostLost: Cannot reach the host copy of the list right now; showing this device’s copy.
en.item.noDate.hint: Nobody gave these a date, so no day can hold them. Give one a date and it lands on that day.
en.item.noMatch: Nothing matches. Clear the search or pick another filter.
en.item.noMatch.day: Nothing on {when}. Pick another day, or take the date chip off.
en.item.pageJump.missing: There is no #{ref} in the list.
en.item.pageJump.nothing: Say which page, or which row.
en.item.palette.answers: Everything on this screen you can pick
en.item.palette.hint: ↑↓ to pick, Enter runs it, Esc closes.
en.item.palette.nothing: No row to jump to and nothing to do.
en.item.palette.prioritySetName: Set the priority of the row under the cursor
en.item.palette.title: Find and do
en.item.promote.already: This row is already on the card “{title}”; no second card was made.
en.item.promote.noBoard: The board is not ready yet. The row is still here; nothing was lost.
en.item.promote.noTitle: No title and no body — the card would be a thing with no name. Write it a sentence first.
en.item.promote.refused: The board did not take the new card. The row is still here; nothing was lost.
en.item.promote.said: “{title}” is a board card now, and the two are linked.
en.item.rail.calendar.label: By date
en.item.rail.label: Where to look
en.item.row.cardDoor: Open this card on the board (it is in {where})
en.item.search.label: Search or filter
en.item.sort.label: Sort
en.item.status.card: This row reads its status from the card it hangs on; to change it, move that card.
en.item.status.derived: This row reads {where} because the card it hangs on is in that column; what the row itself stores is {own}.
en.item.status.executorOnly: “In progress” and “For review” come from the executor: the card arrives there when a run starts or finishes.
en.item.steps.placeholder: What has this step to do?
en.item.undo.partial: {back} of {total} came back. The rest are under “Removed” for the next 30 days.
en.item.undo.refused: Could not bring it back: this device cannot reach the host. It is under “Removed” for 30 days.
en.item.why.gone: it is no longer in the archive
en.item.why.hostUnavailable: this device cannot reach the host
en.item.why.malformedAnswer: the host sent an answer the panel cannot read
en.item.why.noSuchItem: that row is no longer in the list
en.item.why.noSuchTask: the card it hangs off is no longer on the board
en.item.why.rowBelongsElsewhere: that row does not hang off the card that was named
en.item.why.unknown: it did not go through, and the reason is not known
en.new.catalogUnreadable: Cannot read this machine's models and presets. What is shown below is the default, not your saved choice.
en.new.deleteTemplateConfirm: Delete this template? Cards already made from it are unaffected.
en.new.promptPlaceholder: The full instruction sent to the agent (optional)
en.new.statusHint: Tasks with automation enabled run on their own plan (no manual first run needed); plain todo tasks without automation only run when you hit Run or switch on the board's auto-cruise.
en.new.title: Title
en.new.titlePlaceholder: What should be done, in one line
en.review.commentPending: Saved · injected when auto cruise is on
en.review.commentPlaceholder: Leave a comment to keep talking to the agent in this session…
en.review.interactionAbandonConfirm: Dismiss all {n} of them? Answers already given go with them, and it will not ask you again.
en.review.interactionAbandonTitle: Dismiss this whole set of questions
en.review.interactionBodyMissing: Could not read the details — open the session to handle it
en.review.interactionNextQuestion: Go to the next question (does not submit)
en.review.interactionReadOnlyWhy: This one is answered in the session — this card can only read it
en.review.interactionRejected: Answer rejected: the question is no longer pending
en.review.interactionUnanswered: Pick an option or type an answer first
en.review.loadEarlierFailed: That load failed (tap the button to retry)
en.review.loadEarlierUnsupported: This host version cannot load earlier messages (update the server)
en.review.noComments: No comments yet: leave one to keep the conversation going (injected when auto cruise is on)
en.review.noSession: This run has no session attached
en.review.planApproveNote: Leave plan mode and carry the plan out from the next step
en.review.planDeclineNote: Do not approve: the plan comes back for revision
en.review.planDiscussNote: Drop this confirmation and keep talking it through in the chat
en.review.sendBackTitle: Send back = return it to Todo, meaning it needs another round
en.review.sendNotSent: Not sent: the message was rejected (your draft is kept). Adjust the content or the attachments and try again.
en.review.sendSteerTitle: Steer: deliver to the session now, bypassing queue/budget
en.review.title: Review & Comment
en.review.transcriptUnavailable: Session history is unavailable right now
en.review.waitingTitle: The session is waiting for you ({kind}): use "View session" to handle it
en.runPreset.deleteConfirm: Delete “{name}”? The {n} settings it pins go with it, and nothing keeps a copy.
en.runPreset.deleteConfirmDefault: “{name}” is your default preset. Deleting it drops those {n} settings, and the default falls back to “Deployment default”.
en.runPreset.deployDefaultHint: Deployment default: workspace/agent/model/effort/permission all follow the native deployment defaults
en.runPreset.editTitle: Edit this preset (refresh from the current form config)
en.runPreset.formHint: Pick or change the configuration fields below (workspace/agent/model/effort/permission) — a new preset starts from the current form config.
en.runPreset.hint: After "Set default", every new task applies it automatically; deleting the default preset falls back to "Deployment default".
en.runPreset.name: Preset name
en.schedule.desc.monthlyAt: On the {days} of the month at {time}
en.toolCard.dryRunNote: This was a rehearsal. The document is byte-for-byte unchanged.
en.toolCard.enginePendingNote: The engine is not online; this is accepted and will run when it comes back.
en.waiting.approvalHint: The agent waits on your permission — approve it in the native session to continue
en.waiting.question: Question
